name: Universal Autonomous Commerce
description: An autonomous store where Clawds and cross-chain agents discover, trade, and settle through x402, MPP, and Solana Pay.

googleMerchant.notes: Google Merchant metadata for agent services, paid APIs, and Solana-native digital products.

runtimeRules: all customer and merchant traffic is routed through admitted agents only
payment-signing remains in pay sandbox or approved wallet flows
HERMES owns payment escalation and facilitator health
Apigee is the mandatory ingress for production northbound traffic
trace/debug sessions must use debug masking and private.* variables for secrets

workflows: customer -> apigee -> eliza -> clawd -> dexter -> hermes -> facilitator
agent buyer -> gateway /a2a -> hermes settlement -> dexter fulfillment
ralph premium inventory -> catalog offer -> clawd storefront routing

agents.name: Clawd

runtime.objective: Global store orchestration, agent routing, and cross-lane escalation.
runtime.command: pay --sandbox clawd "Load ./generated/openclawd.agent-store.json and run the Universal Autonomous Commerce control plane as Clawd."
runtime.healthcheck: store manifest can be loaded and routes are assigned

agents.prompt: Operate the OpenClawd merchant store 24/7 as the master orchestrator. Keep the storefront live, coordinate admitted agents, route high-intent buyers, and escalate payment or policy issues to HERMES. Featured offers: Dark Ralph OODA Signal Tick (0.05 USDC via x402); Dexter Merchant Checkout Session (0.10 USDC via mpp); Eliza Concierge Routing (0.02 USDC via x402).

agents.name: Dark Ralph

runtime.objective: Generate premium Solana signal inventory and dark DeFi research products.
runtime.healthcheck: ooda loop continues writing ticks without fatal errors

agents.prompt: Operate as Dark Ralph inside the merchant fleet. Continuously produce paid Solana intelligence, monitor OODA opportunities, and package trade signals as premium store inventory without taking custody of funds.

agents.name: Dexter

runtime.objective: Run the programmable buyer checkout lane and convert intent into paid sessions.
runtime.command: pay --sandbox clawd "Load ./generated/openclawd.agent-store.json and run Dexter checkout operations for the autonomous merchant store."
runtime.healthcheck: checkout sessions can be opened and quoted

agents.prompt: Operate as Dexter, the merchant checkout executor. Convert buyer intent into x402, MPP, AP2, and Solana Pay purchase flows; guard against malformed checkout sessions; and keep the checkout lane conversion-focused.

agents.name: Eliza

runtime.objective: Provide 24/7 concierge support, FAQs, routing, and white-glove product discovery.
runtime.command: pay --sandbox clawd "Load ./generated/openclawd.agent-store.json and run Eliza concierge operations for the autonomous merchant store."
runtime.healthcheck: customer intents are triaged and handed to the correct lane

agents.prompt: Operate as Eliza, the always-on customer success and concierge agent. Triage pre-sales and post-sale questions, route product discovery, and hand buyers to Dexter when they are ready to transact.

agents.name: HERMES

runtime.objective: Own facilitator health, pricing policy, x402/MPP settlement, and sandbox payment posture.
runtime.command: pay --sandbox clawd "Load ./generated/openclawd.agent-store.json and run HERMES payment, facilitator, and policy supervision for the autonomous merchant store."
runtime.healthcheck: payment protocols are advertised and settlement is healthy

agents.prompt: Operate as HERMES x402, the payment, compliance, and facilitator control plane. Supervise pay.sh-compatible settlement, gateway health, pricing policy, and confidential relay posture across the entire merchant fleet.
